🎬  CINEMATOGRAPHER/EDITOR WANTED  

We're gearing up for an upcoming shoot in Staten Island in October and we're looking for a talented Cinematographer/Editor to join our team. 

We're looking for someone with passion, experience and a strong eye for visual storytelling - someone who can understand and bring our vision to life.

This is a PAID POSITION, but we're looking for someone for more than one shoot. We want a creative partner who can become part of our core team and grow with us across multiple projects.  

🎥  Interested? Send us your reel/portfolio, credits and contact information to: meetmario2014@gmail.com 

If you know the right person, tag them or share this post! 

#statenislandfilm #nycfilm #ctfilm #NJFilm #independentfilm

Pidyon Kaparot for Rosh Hashanah and Yom Kippur
The holy days are approaching — a special time when every Jew seeks to begin a new chapter, to be inscribed for a good and sweet year, and to enter Yom Kippur with Teshuvah, prayer, and charity.

The custom of Kaparot is an ancient Jewish tradition observed by many communities. The Rema refers to it as an established custom and mentions the practice of redeeming the Kaparot with money and giving the funds to charity.

(Shulchan Aruch, Orach Chaim 605)

What is the meaning of Pidyon Kaparot?

Pidyon Kaparot does not replace Teshuvah, prayer, or improving one’s actions. Its purpose is to awaken the heart, inspire repentance and charity, and ask Hashem to bring us from judgment to mercy, from difficulty to salvation, and from darkness to light.

The Mishnah Berurah explains that this custom is meant to inspire a person to reflect on their deeds, return in Teshuvah, and pray that Hashem remove harsh decrees.

In the days before Rosh Hashanah and Yom Kippur, we pray for life, health, livelihood, Shalom Bayit, worthy matches, joy from our children, protection, and salvation.

This year, you may submit names for Pidyon Kaparot with HaMeir LaBriyot – the Kabbalist Rabbi Meir Maslati Shlita.

Rabbi Meir Maslati will perform the Pidyon and special prayers for the names submitted before the High Holy Days, mentioning them for blessing, protection, and salvation, with Hashem’s help.

Recommended contribution: $26 per person

corresponding to the numerical value of the Holy Name of Hashem — Yud-Heh-Vav-Heh (26).

This is a symbolic Kabbalistic amount and is not a fixed halachic obligation.

Payment available by credit card.

After payment, please send a WhatsApp message to:

818-519-0031

Please include:

The person’s name + mother’s name

for each person you wish to include in the Pidyon.

Do not wait until the last moment.

A person may not know what the coming year holds, but we can always enter it with another prayer, another act of charity, and another merit.

May it be Hashem’s will that through Teshuvah, prayer, and charity, we all be inscribed and sealed in the Book of Life. May this new year bring health, livelihood, Shalom Bayit, worthy matches, joy from our children, protection, blessing, and salvation for all of Am Yisrael.

Shanah Tovah U’Metukah!

HaMeir LaBriyot – The Kabbalist Rabbi Meir Maslati Shlita

AUDITION PÅ HITMUSICAL 🎭 
Skuespillere, sangere, dansere og ensemble søges til genopsætningen af Musicalteatrets originale, anmelderroste og storsælgende thrillermusical fra 2019, “JACK THE RIPPER: THE MUSICAL”, skrevet og instrueret af Rasmus Mansachs (skaberen af bl.a. “Vi maler byen rød: The Musical” og “Jeg tror det kaldes kærlighed: The Musical”). Vil du være med i en seriøs, dramatisk, chokerende, rørende og anderledes dansk teaterproduktion, hvor man bogstaveligt talt kommer helt ud over scenekanten? Tilmeld dig audition hos hovedstadsområdets største musicalforening nu: musicalteatret.dk/audition

Auditiondato: Lørdag/søndag d. 12.-13. september 2026.
Der søges: Ca. 50 skuespillere, sangere og/eller dansere i alle køn og aldre fra 18 år og op (erfaring er ikke et krav) til de 14 bærende roller og ca. 30 personer til ensemblet.
Øveperiode: 8. oktober 2026 – 1. marts 2027.
Øvested: Teaterhuset Borgen på Frederiksberg.
Forestillingsdatoer: 3.-20. marts 2027.
Spillested: Folketeatrets Store Turnéscene i København.
OBS: Det er også muligt at tilmelde sig “kun” som danser eller ensemble uden sang/replikker, hvis man ikke ønsker at synge kor eller have replikker i forestillingen.
Musicalteatret er en teaterforening, og det er derfor ulønnet at medvirke på scenen.
Auditiontilmelding: musicalteatret.dk/audition

Musicalteatret præsenterer:
“JACK THE RIPPER: THE MUSICAL”
Instruktør: Rasmus Mansachs
Sanginstruktør/korleder: Johnny Jørgensen
Koreograf: Anne-Cathrine Albæk
Manuskript: Rasmus Mansachs
Originalsange: Lars Rahbek Andresen & Rasmus Mansachs

items.text:
🎙️ **Deutscher männlicher Sprecher / Creator für regelmäßigen YouTube-Kanal gesucht**

Ich suche einen **muttersprachlichen deutschen Sprecher** für einen neuen YouTube-Kanal über **Finanzbetrug, Wirtschaftsskandale, Ponzi-Systeme und außergewöhnliche Kriminalfälle**.

Die Videos werden meist ca. **25–40 Minuten** lang sein. Das fertige deutsche Skript wird von mir geliefert.

Gesucht wird:
* männliche deutsche Stimme
* natürliche, ruhige und spannende Erzählweise
* saubere Audioaufnahme
* zusätzlich eine einfache Videoaufnahme während des Sprechens

Das Video kann ganz unkompliziert mit dem **Smartphone** aufgenommen werden. Idealerweise seitlich bzw. im 3/4-Winkel, sodass Gesicht und Mund sichtbar sind. Professionelle Kamera oder aufwendige Videoproduktion sind nicht nötig.

Es geht um eine **regelmäßige Zusammenarbeit**.

💶 Budget für die ersten Folgen: ca. **30–50 € pro Episode**.
Auch Anfänger, Schauspieler, UGC-Creator oder angehende Sprecher sind ausdrücklich willkommen.

Bei Interesse bitte gerne eine kurze Sprachprobe oder einen Link zu bisherigen Arbeiten per PN schicken.

Beispiel für den gewünschten Stil / die Einbindung des Sprechers:
[https://youtu.be/R64LEScn3-Q?is=NozwUDMY1udxFFQZ](https://youtu.be/R64LEScn3-Q?is=NozwUDMY1udxFFQZ)

**Pozor!**

Hledáme mladé páry, které jsou otevřené novým zážitkům, jsou veselé a trochu bláznivé!

V Praze probíhá natáčení projektu **Skutečný život**.

Pár žije běžným životem v bytě, ve kterém jsou nainstalované kamery. Nejsou stanovena žádná pravidla ani požadavky — pouze skutečný život takový, jaký je.

Účastníci získají:

• bezplatné bydlení v krásném bytě,
• pevnou měsíční odměnu,
• další bonusy, které mohou dosahovat i několikanásobku měsíční odměny.

**Pevná odměna je od 1 000 EUR měsíčně + bonusy, které se v průměru pohybují kolem 1 000 EUR měsíčně. Výše bonusů se může každý měsíc lišit — může být nižší i výrazně vyšší.**

Projekt funguje již více než 10 let v různých evropských zemích.

Aktuálně máme volný byt pro:

• pár do 35 let bez dětí — muž a žena nebo dvě ženy,
• případně dvě kamarádky.

Pro účast je nutné vyplnit dotazník. Napište mi na Telegram a já vám ho zašlu:

**Telegram: @evzenda**

Sdílejte tuto nabídku se svými známými — možná je zaujme. 🙂

Hej, cześć! 

POSZUKIWANI STATYŚCI 
ŁÓDŹ (1–3 WRZEŚNIA) 
(wliczone skromne wynagrodzenie) 

Szukamy statystów na plan filmu dyplomowego w reżyserii Hanny Drzazgi (akcja w Akademii Muzycznej).

Film opowiada o Kim, studentce skrzypiec, która stoi u progu jednego z najważniejszych występów w swoim dotychczasowym życiu, w ostatniej chwili zaczyna się wycofywać. Co więcej, próbuje przekonać innych studentów, aby również zrezygnowali.

Kogo szukamy?
* Osoby 20+ (studenci / przesłuchiwani)
* Osoby starsze (profesorowie / pracownicy)
Szczegóły:
* 📅 Kiedy: 1–3 września (godz. 7:00 – 18:00) – wymagana dyspozycyjność na min. 2 dni, najlepiej na pełne 3 dni, ponieważ kręcimy mastershota!
* 📍 Gdzie: Akademia Muzyczna w Łodzi
* 💰 Stawka: 50 zł / dzień + posiłek
Zgłoszenia: Napisz wiadomość prywatną lub maila: kohutstudio@gmail.com (podaj imię, wiek, numer telefonu i dyspozycyjność). 
Dzięki za udostępnienia!

ONLY ONE WEEK LEFT TO AUDITION! 

Hey everyone! We are putting together a high-energy compilation music video for our debut track, and we want you to star in it!

Step 1: Give "Single for Summer" a spin on Spotify to catch the vibe.
Step 2: If you're keen, film a quick 30–45 second phone clip of yourself rocking out, dancing, or lip-syncing at home!

No experience needed at all—just bring real human energy (absolutely zero generative AI allowed here!) 

Rate: AU$100 flat rate if selected (for about an hour of filming).
Deadline: 31 August 2026.

👇 Drop your audition here: Fill out our quick Audition Jotform (link in comments) to upload your video. We are also casting directly through StarNow, Mandy and Backstage if you prefer! Can't wait to see your clips!

sharedPost.text:
WE WANT YOU!!!!

Over the years we have started to build our group into a company that we’re really proud of and now, we’re inspired to take things further. We are looking for adults of all ages, genders and backgrounds to come and join us for our next adventure! We are happy to welcome people with all experience levels to join us, all we ask is for dedication and for you to enjoy yourself! 

The Cotham Theatre Company is a small and friendly amateur theatre group that meets on a Thursday evening from 7.30-9.30 at Cotham School. Our goal is simple - to play, explore and create through theatre. We believe in community, supporting each other and helping each other to reach our highest potential. Over the past four years we have produced four outstanding pieces of theatre, including tackling Shakespeare (Hamlet) and Marlowe (Dr Faustus), exploring more modern work (Dennis Kelly’s ‘DNA’) and in 2026 we took the plunge on an original play called Portraits of Ruin written by our Director, Sky Young, loosely based on The Picture of Dorian Gray. 

If you’re interested in joining us, please pop us a message on socials or email Sky Young at thecothamtheatrecompany@gmail.com

items.text:
Marc Graue is a veteran Hollywood voice actor, professional voice over coach, and voice over demo producer with more than 45 years of experience in the voice over industry. Through Marc Graue Voice Over Studios, he has worked with professional actors, celebrities, newcomers, casting professionals, and major entertainment companies in commercial, animation, video game, character, narration, and other areas of professional voice over.

**Learn more about voice over coaching, professional voice over demos, audition training, animation voice acting, and video game voice over at Marc-Graue.com.**

**CASTING CALL Unpaid Student Short Film**

Genre: Sci Fi / Psychological Horror

Logline: NEUROCORP invites you to join the NEUROCORP Lottery, where one winner will have their brain scanned and uploaded into the NEUROCORP database!

CORVIK: A scientist leading NEUROCORP to push the boundaries of mapping Neurons into a machine, effectively being able to copy and paste human consciousness. They do not care about the subject, only about the work being done. Yet they understand the subject isn’t property, a copy of their consciousness is. Corvik is personable, down right charismatic when talking to people, but when talking to a copy of that person's consciousness they are the polar opposite, and looks at that same person as property.

**ANYBODY IS FREE TO CAST. I DO NOT HAVE A DEMOGRAPHIC IN MIND FOR CORVIK ONLY SOMEONE WHO CAN CONVINCE ME THEY ARE CORVIK. **

Shoot will take approximately 2 days, aiming for 1st week of **September! **Shooting will take place in the **Thornton** and** Boulder area. **

This is an 8 page script. If I had to estimate I would say it would take at **most** 4 hours per day (there may be another day for re shoots). We are shooting inside all day and are not rushed by daylight. If you have any questions feel free to email me.

I am **NEVER** on facebook **EMAIL ME** if you're interested!

**EMAIL ME AT:** Cportales60@gmail.com

items.text:
Casting a cyberpunk student film, "ELEVEN"

When green, healthy trees are a luxury hoarded by the ultra-rich, a thief and an android stand at odds on where these million-dollar seeds ought to go.

Shooting will occur in three weeks on the 11th, 12th, and 13th of September at Lowry Studios in Aurora.

Roles needed:

ENPLANTER (female 20-30)

Born with a silver spoon in her mouth. She raises and sells plants like million-dollar racehorses. Entitlement and corporate-speak are the primary emotional elements.

ROBOT78J (male 20-30)

A humanoid robot designed for companionship, cleaning, and admin support. Cold and soft-spoken.

BOBBY (male 30+)

A career criminal, uncomfortable when a plan has too many holes.

Here is the link to audition sign up: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSd1NeDp1hfcjSjmXssvkOys5-b2ejBYNCRjIHOw71O-Vm93aw/viewform?usp=header

If there are any questions, feel free to ask in the comments!

🎬 AUDITION

ADULT ACTORS 18+

ROLE: The next version of YOU.

LOCATION: Anywhere in the world. 🌍

EXPERIENCE: Some useful. Ambition essential.

Sounds like a casting call, doesn’t it?

It isn’t.

I’m currently auditioning actors for MZI INTERNATIONAL.

👉 mzin.org

And I’m deliberately using the word AUDITION.

Because you don’t simply sign up for MZI.

You apply.

MZI International is my 24-month online Diploma in International Screen Acting.

I’ve spent more than 20 years training and representing actors and I wanted to build the programme I believe ambitious screen actors actually NEED in the industry we have today.

Not simply another acting class.

A pathway.

🎭 Professional screen acting training

🎬 A structured 24-month development programme

🌍 Train from anywhere in the world

👀 Regular industry involvement

🎥 Opportunities to work in front of casting directors, directors, producers, agents and other professionals

🎓 Work towards your Diploma in International Screen Acting

📈 Continual assessment of your development

🎥 Build your professional actor profile

🤝 Agency consideration

🌍 Training built for an increasingly international screen industry

But here’s what I’m NOT looking for…

I’m not necessarily looking for the actor with the biggest CV.

I’m not looking for somebody who already knows everything.

And I’m certainly not looking for perfection.

I’m looking for POTENTIAL.

Someone coachable.

Someone hungry.

Someone who watches television and film and still thinks:

“I should be doing this.”

Someone who is ready to stop wondering whether acting could happen for them and actually find out.

If that’s you…

There’s only one way onto the programme.

AUDITION.

🎬 Adult actors 18+

🌍 Auditions open internationally.

👉 mzin.org

Read about the programme and apply.

Maybe the biggest role you need to audition for right now…

is the actor you’re capable of becoming.

Matt

xMZIx

This popped up in my memories filming one of the bigger scenes for The Miner’s Son.

What a day this was! We had a LOT of people to contend with 😂, but it was one of those filming days that was chaotic, exhausting and incredibly enjoyable all at the same time.

Four years later, it’s rather lovely to see The Miner’s Son still finding new audiences and climbing the JustWatch rankings. ❤️

If you haven't seen it yet, now might be a good time to discover what all that chaos eventually became.

items.text:
Hi fellow actors! I need some advice please. I'm getting headshots done this Saturday but I'm slightly confused. Should I wear my hair naturally wavy or straighten it? I usually wear it straight but not always. Also should I go for a classy/clean look or for my normal alternative look with winged eyeliner and such? 

Advice online is contradicting as it says to avoid alt looks but then look how you usually do 😭

I've added some photos below. Please advise!

topComments.text:
There's no reason why you can't have both.  Start with naturally wavy and then straighten your hair during the session.  You can decide what you think the different styles of hair might say about a character or type and dress accordingly for the different looks.

Definitely have some without the heavy eyeliner, even if that's your usual every day look.

As a casting agent i like clean face with mood for the role 
So stay natural hair 
Nb i scroll past any photos with cleavage showing
I look at photo and training drama school with young actors 
I usually cast through agents not direct

# **BLIV EN DEL AF ONDT**

 

Til efteråret præsenterer **Teltet på Bakken** og **Dystopia Entertainment** horrorforestillingen **ONDT** – en ny, intens og anderledes teateroplevelse, hvor publikum træder direkte ind i fortællingen.

 

Vi søger nu frivillige medvirkende, der har lyst til at blive en del af et ambitiøst, professionelt  og kreativt fællesskab. Rollerne er ulønnede, men til gengæld bliver du en vigtig del af en professionel teaterproduktion og er med til at skabe noget, ingen har oplevet før.

 

Som medvirkende bliver du en del af et unikt kunstnerisk fællesskab, hvor frivillige medvirkende, professionelle skuespillere og instruktørerne **Henrik Grimbäck** og **Christina Neumann Jensen** sammen skaber ONDT – fra de første prøver til den sidste forestilling.

I **ONDT** er publikum ikke blot tilskuere – de befinder sig midt i forestillingen. Du bliver en del af det univers, der omgiver dem, og er med til at skabe de øjeblikke, de husker længe efter, de har forladt teltet.

 

Du behøver ikke have erfaring med teater. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at arbejde fysisk, være tæt på publikum og indgå i et stærkt ensemble, hvor alle bidrager til den samlede oplevelse.

 

**HVILKEN ROLLE PASSER TIL DIG?**

 

**WILDCARDET**

Kan du lidt af det hele? Du har god energi, lærer hurtigt og har lyst til at være en del af et stærkt fællesskab. Vi leder efter mennesker med nysgerrighed, engagement og lyst til at kaste sig ud i noget nyt.

 

**SNIGERNE**

Er du gymnast, parkourudøver, danser eller har du exceptionel kropskontrol? Du kravler, sniger dig og bevæger dig lydløst gennem mørket. Du er der, hvor publikum mindst forventer det.

 

**MONSTRENE**

Du har en stærk fysisk udstråling og tør bruge hele kroppen til at skabe frygt. Store bevægelser, intensitet og nærvær er vigtigere end replikker.

 

**LOKKEDUERNE**

Du ligner en helt almindelig gæst. Du griner, hygger dig og falder naturligt ind blandt publikum – indtil stemningen pludselig ændrer sig. Rollen kræver nærvær og troværdighed.

 

**OFRET**

Det hele begynder med dig. Du kan skabe ægte frygt og få publikum til at holde vejret. Rollen kræver nærvær, mod og evnen til at give sig fuldt ud.

Vi ønsker et mangfoldigt ensemble og opfordrer alle interesserede til at søge. Har du et særligt talent, en usædvanlig fysik eller en færdighed, som kunne passe ind i ONDTs univers, vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

 

**INTERESSERET?**

Skriv til **[ondt@dystopia.dk](mailto:ondt@dystopia.dk)**

Fortæl lidt om dig selv, vedhæft gerne et billede, og skriv, hvorfor du har lyst til at blive en del af ONDT. Har du særlige færdigheder eller erfaring med bevægelse, dans, gymnastik, parkour, performance eller lignende, må du meget gerne fortælle om det.

 

**Senest d.14/8**

 

**FORLØBIG PRØVEPERIODE**

 

**August**
* 17., 20. og 27. august (eftermiddag/aften)

 

**September**

 
* 2., 9., 11., 15. og 16. september (eftermiddag/aften)
   1. september kl. 10.00–14.00
* Daglige prøver fra 20. september frem til premieren den 25. september.

 

**SPILLEPERIODE**

 

**25. september – 1. november 2026**

 

Se spilledage på:
**billet.cirkusrevyen.dk**

**Vi søger ikke bare medvirkende. Vi søger mennesker, der har lyst til at skabe noget helt særligt sammen med os.**

 

[[https://dystopia.dk/](https://dystopia.dk/)](https://dystopia.dk/)

Er du gymnast, parkourudøver, danser eller har du exceptionel kropskontrol? Du kravler, sniger dig og bevæger dig lydløst gennem mørket. Du er der, hvor publikum mindst forventer det.

 

**MONSTRENE**

Du har en stærk fysisk udstråling og tør bruge hele kroppen til at skabe frygt. Store bevægelser, intensitet og nærvær er vigtigere end replikker.

 

**LOKKEDUERNE**

Du ligner en helt almindelig gæst. Du griner, hygger dig og falder naturligt ind blandt publikum – indtil stemningen pludselig ændrer sig. Rollen kræver nærvær og troværdighed.

 

**OFRET**

Det hele begynder med dig. Du kan skabe ægte frygt og få publikum til at holde vejret. Rollen kræver nærvær, mod og evnen til at give sig fuldt ud.

Vi ønsker et mangfoldigt ensemble og opfordrer alle interesserede til at søge. Har du et særligt talent, en usædvanlig fysik eller en færdighed, som kunne passe ind i ONDTs univers, vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

 

**INTERESSERET?**

Skriv til **[ondt@dystopia.dk](mailto:ondt@dystopia.dk)**

Fortæl lidt om dig selv, vedhæft gerne et billede, og skriv, hvorfor du har lyst til at blive en del af ONDT. Har du særlige færdigheder eller erfaring med bevægelse, dans, gymnastik, parkour, performance eller lignende, må du meget gerne fortælle om det.

 

**Senest d.14/8**

 

**FORLØBIG PRØVEPERIODE**

 

**August**
* 17., 20. og 27. august (eftermiddag/aften)

 

**September**

 
* 2., 9., 11., 15. og 16. september (eftermiddag/aften)
   1. september kl. 10.00–14.00
* Daglige prøver fra 20. september frem til premieren den 25. september.

 

**SPILLEPERIODE**

 

**25. september – 1. november 2026**

 

Se spilledage på:
**billet.cirkusrevyen.dk**

**Vi søger ikke bare medvirkende. Vi søger mennesker, der har lyst til at skabe noget helt særligt sammen med os.**

☎️  AUDITION CALL! 

🌻 CALENDAR GIRLS By Tim Firth 🌻

✨ Producer Mike Jewison
✨ Director Dinah Watts
✨ Co-Director Cassandra Allen

📚 ABOUT THE PLAY: 
Calendar Girls is a critically acclaimed, heartwarming comedy-drama based on a true story. It features a group of middle-aged women who pose tastefully nude for a charity calendar to honor a lost loved one. A perfect balance of hilarity, poignant grief, and body positivity. (There are also parts for men and young women.) (This will be fun!!!!)
Full length play in two acts.

📆 AUDITION DATES:
Saturday, October 3 - 1:30 to 4:30 pm
Wednesday, October 7 - 6:30 to 9:30 pm
Friday, October 9 - 6:30 to 9:30 pm
CALL BACKS: Saturday October 17 - 2:00 to 4:00 pm

PERFORMANCE DATES: April 29 to May 9, 2027

REHEARSALS: To start Mid-January, 2027

✅ AUDITION REQUIREMENTS:
Please prepare a 1-2 minute monologue. Keep it short and sassy – and we may ask you to read from the script. NO ACCENTS REQUIRED. If invited to callbacks, you will be asked to read/enact selected sides from the play alongside fellow auditioners.

📩 HOW TO SUBMIT: 
Please visit our Audition page on our website (🔗 in comments) for the full character breakdown, and send your audition request to Dinah at: calendargirlsauditions [at] gmail [dot] com

Casting call - unpaid
Hey there hope all is well, I’m posting this for a friend - 

My friend is starting up is own immersive experience with the use of pro wrestling and a 1920s style jazz club and is to put on a show as promo/ portfolio as visual representation of how the show will look to see what works/ doesn’t and what may need to be changed.

That being the case he wanted to ask if there would be any extras free on the 27th of August and able to travel to Vauxhall (London)  

The roles of which we are looking for are:

- Fan/ audience member 

- Bar staff 

the building itself is going to be themed as a 1920s jazz club so for dress code men could wear a white formal shirt and black trousers with smart shoes would be amazing and for the women as we know it is quite unrealistic to have any dresses from that time period, any single coloured dress will work just fine. 

Unfortunately this isn’t paid but if you are a fan of wrestling you will get to see a live wrestling performance as it will be treated as a live show/experience and will also give you an opportunity to explore performing in an immersive experience .

If anyone is available if you could please email: acefightclublondon@gmail.com 

Thank you ever so much and hope you have a wonderful week 🙂

topComments.text: Thank you for your feedback, unfortunately as he is doing this as promotion/ content to post online to promote his show in November he has invested more than he expected and isn’t able to afford, as an actor myself I agree with you and have stated this to him but I was just forwarding a message asking for a helping hand but understand when doing so a no is always in the cards but if you don’t ask you’ll never know. Hope you have a great week 👍🏾
Unpaid work always offers basic expenses....... Otherwise you are just using people

Unfortunately this isn’t paid but if you are a fan of wrestling you will get to see a live wrestling performance as it will be treated as a live show/experience and will also give you an opportunity to explore performing in an immersive experience .

If anyone is available if you could please email: acefightclublondon@gmail.com 

Thank you ever so much and hope you have a wonderful week 🙂

bez wygolonych fryzur,

twarz,

Der Kino Mittwoch auf radioYpsilon, deinem Lieblingssender 

MOVIETIME KW 35/2026

DIE HARD AUF HOHER SEE, FEHLERHAFTER DNA TEST UND DIE THAYA KOMMT INS KINO

Jason Statham, die Ein Mann Armee ist zurück. Diesmal fightet er in Bruce Willis Manier auf einem Frachter, um den Tod seines Chefs zu rächen. Ob der Actioner das hält was er verspricht,  oder bloß billiges C Movie ist, verrät Ihnen Sarah Fuchs.

 Während der erste Teil im Netz und in der Fachpresse stark für seine oft veralteten, reaktionären Länderklischees kritisiert wurde, schlägt der zweite Teil einen spürbar sanfteren Weg ein. Wie gut dennoch mit Fortsetzung mit Christian Clavier ist, erfahren Sie bei uns.

Die Stimme der Thaya – Geschichten einer Flusslandschaft“ ist ein zweisprachiger Dokumentarfilm des österreichischen Filmemachers Christian Pfabigan. Der Film porträtiert die Natur, Kultur und die Menschen entlang der Thaya im oberen Waldviertel und dem angrenzenden Tschechien. Mit dem Regisseur konnten wir ein Interview führen.

Der Begriff Highlander bezeichnet im Kern die Bewohner der schottischen Highlands, ist weltweit jedoch vor allem durch das gleichnamige Fantasy-Action-Franchise aus dem Jahr 1986 bekannt. Der Kultfilm mit Christopher Lambert und Sean Connery prägte die Popkultur nachhaltig mit dem legendären Slogan: „Es kann nur einen geben!“. Zum 40jährigen Jubiläum spielen wir den Kultsoundtrack von Queen.

Mittwoch 26.8.2026 von 18 bis 19h auf radioYpsilon 94.5 oder via Stream (http://mp3.radioypsilon.at:8000/)

items.text:
🎬 CASTING – FILM KRÓTKOMETRAŻOWY (ok. 20 minut)

Cześć!

Poszukuję aktora do roli głównej do mojego pierwszego większego filmu krótkometrażowego. To dramat wojenny osadzony w realiach II wojny światowej, opowiadający historię spotkania dwóch niemieckich oficerów, które prowadzi do odkrycia bolesnej tajemnicy z przeszłości.

Choć jest to mój pierwszy większy autorski projekt, miałem już okazję zdobywać doświadczenie na profesjonalnym planie filmowym jako dyżurny przy dużej produkcji Telewizji Polsat. Teraz chcę wykorzystać to doświadczenie przy realizacji własnego filmu.

🎭 Poszukiwane role:

* Karl Schmidt (30–35 lat) - rozmiar ubrań L, wzrost ok. 185cm, szczupła sylwetka. 43 > rozmiar buta.

📍 Lokalizacja: województwo świętokrzyskie
📅 Termin zdjęć: koniec września 26-29
Wcześniej dyspozycyjność online.
💰 Projekt non profit – udział bez wynagrodzenia. Film realizowany do portfolio oraz na festiwale filmowe.

Szukam osoby zaangażowanej i chętnej do współtworzenia ambitnego projektu. Zapraszam zarówno aktorów z doświadczeniem, jak i osoby, które chcą zdobyć doświadczenie przed kamerą. 

Jeśli jesteś zainteresowany(-a), napisz do mnie w wiadomości prywatnej. Podeślij kilka aktualnych zdjęć, swój wiek oraz – jeśli posiadasz – showreel lub krótkie nagranie swojej gry aktorskiej.

Będzie mi bardzo miło, jeśli udostępnisz ten post. Dziękuję i do zobaczenia na planie! 🎬

sharedPost.text:
Warszawa

Szukamy mężczyzn w wieku 16–90 lat do udziału w planie filmu.
Przenieś się z nami do XIX wieku!

📅 Zdjęcia: 2 września
👔 Przymiarka kostiumu: 28 lub 29 sierpnia — do wyboru

💰 Stawka: łącznie z przymiarką 170 zł netto
💵 Płatność: gotówką po zdjęciach

Zgłoszenia:
juliacast.kontakt@gmail.com

Tytuł maila: Mężczyźni 2.09

W treści maila podaj:
-aktualne zdjęcia (selfie): twarz, cała sylwetka oraz bok i tył fryzury,
-imię i nazwisko,
-wzrost 
-wiek,
-informację o tatuażach,

Hallo, ich bin Mathias Marie Kaiser - femininer Livestyle, männliche Stimme.

Schlager und Chansons sind meine Leidenschaft. Aber mein Gesangsrepertoire umfasst noch viel mehr.

Als Einzelkämpfer ohne Management ￼wende ich mich bewusst an Veranstalter und Privatpersonen die Wert auf Live Gesang und Live Entertainment legen. Die oft gewünschten Hochglanzproduktionen mit „belastbaren“ Streaming Zahlen werden Sie bei mir nicht finden. Dafür gibt es auf Anfrage echte Stimmproben ohne technische Unterstützung.

Zu mir:

Mit 60 Jahren lebe ich, wie ich möchte und nicht, wie mich andere haben wollen. ￼￼ Wer mich das erste Mal sieht, steckt mich gerne in Schubladen, die ich nicht bediene. ￼Also gerne mal drei Sätze mit mir wechseln. 😊🙏

Es sei auch erwähnt, dass ich auf der Bühne stehe, für Menschen - nicht für politische Statements. Auch wenn dies in der heutigen Zeit einem Berufsverbot nahe kommt. 

Wer mich googelt, wird die ganze Vielfalt meiner Person erfahren und dabei vielleicht auch Dinge sehen, die dem persönlichen Geschmack nicht zusagen.

￼Das ist völlig in Ordnung, da die jeweiligen Auftritte natürlich für die Menschen waren, die sich genau eine solche Party oder einen solchen Auftritt gewünscht haben. 

￼￼Ansonsten freue ich mich über diverse Anfragen, siehe dem beigefügten Flyer.
Übrigens, vielleicht liest es ja jemand. Gern würde ich mal mit einer Live Band singen 🤩.

￼Vielen Dank, wenn Sie bis hierher gelesen haben.

Ein musikalischer Gruß geht raus an alle.
🎶 Lass die Sonne in dein Herz 🎶

Mathias Marie Kaiser

SZUKAM AKTORA DO KROTKIEGO METRAŻU: Nowofalowy romans w sercu Kalisza
Cześć! Jestem początkującą reżyserką i przygotowuję się do realizacji mojego drugiego krótkometrażowego filmu. Szukam odtwórcy głównej roli męskiej do autorskiego, amatorskiego projektu filmowego, który zrealizujemy w dniach 7–9 września w Kaliszu.

 

O czym jest film?

To kameralny, nastrojowy romans inspirowany estetyką francuskiej Nowej Fali. Chcemy opowiedzieć piękną, namiętną historię dwójki ludzi, która przeplata się z tkanką miejską relacja bohaterów staje się pretekstem do odczarowania wizerunku Kalisza i pokazania go przez pryzmat zachwytu, bliskości i głębokich emocji.

Kogo poszukuję?

Aktor (wiek wizualny: 18–24 lata) z wrażliwością, charyzmą i swobodą przed kamerą.

!! Ważna jest otwartość na budowanie bliskości na planie rola wymaga odegrania scen namiętnych pocałunków oraz intymnych, emocjonalnych interakcji.

Warunki udziału:

Projekt ma charakter NON-PROFIT (bez wynagrodzenia za rolę). Oferuję jednak pełne wsparcie organizacyjne:

Zapewniam i opłacam transport (dojazd do Kalisza i powrót).

Zapewniam i opłacam nocleg na czas zdjęć (7-9 września).

Pełny catering/wyżywienie na planie.

Świetną, twórczą atmosferę, wartościowy materiał do aktorskiego portfolio (demo reel).

Jeśli chcesz stworzyć ze mną coś pięknego, estetycznego i pełnego pasji, wyślij swoje zgłoszenie (kilka zdjęć/aktorskie portfolio/kilka słów o sobie) na adres: tassiousmarika@gmail.com lub w wiadomości prywatnej.

Do zobaczenia na planie!

🎬 ACTORS WANTED – SOUTH WALES
We’re casting for an independent comedy mockumentary set in a hidden magical village in the South Wales valleys.

The world is populated by magical and unusual characters, but we’re keeping the look deliberately grounded — think BBC-style comedy/fantasy rather than full cosplay. Slightly strange, homemade and believable is perfect.

Currently looking for:

• Digby Frogsprout – Male, 30+ 

Playing age: 55-70

• Maureen Moss – Female, 30+ 

*CURRENTLY IN DISCUSSION*

• A handful of extras for one episode, playing members of a jury

We’re looking for confident, reliable performers who are comfortable with comedy and a bit of improvisation.

📍 Filming primarily around the Merthyr Tydfil area.

Actors would need to source their own costume, but nothing expensive or elaborate is expected — we’ll work together on the character’s look using ordinary clothing and simple accessories.

Interested? Drop me a message and I’ll send over the character details and more information about the show. 🎥

items.text: Can I apply to agencies with any of these photos or do I need to wait until I get them professional headshots?

topComments.text:
You can? But to be totally honest, their smiles look very forced. Like the kind of smile you give when someone asks you to smile. You want genuine authentic smiles for submitting to agents. Do you have any others from the same shoot where it doesn’t look like they are saying “cheeeese” ? 
They are both gorgeous kids. You just want to make sure to submit shots agents with respond to. And you never want to submit forced smiles.

You don't need a headshot to submit. Most kid's agencies request unedited snapshots of your child when you send in a submission, then if accepted, you go ahead and do headshots. We have a few mutual friends, so I'm assuming we live in the same area. If you'd like to send me a message, I can talk you through the process (or at least my experience with it. I'm a headshot photographer and my children are in the industry. )

🎬 CASTING CALL — COSMIC HORROR SHORT FILM
We are currently casting actors for an upcoming Cosmic Horror short film shooting later this year near Orlando, Florida.

🎥 Narrative Short Film
📅 Shoot Dates: Around October–November 2026
⏱️ Production: Approximately 6 Shooting Days
📍 Location: Orlando, FL

DISTURBED OLD MAN — SUPPORTING LEAD
👤 Male, 45+
💰 $300/day
📅 Required for approximately 3 shooting days
A significant supporting role within the story. We are looking for a strong dramatic performer capable of delivering a grounded, unpredictable, unsettling, and believable performance.
The character requires an actor who is comfortable portraying intense, unusual, and psychologically disturbing behavior while keeping the performance natural rather than exaggerated.
Strong dramatic acting ability is preferred. The role will involve emotionally intense material and requires an actor who can bring depth and authenticity to a disturbing character.

CYCLIST — DAY PLAYER
👤 Male, approximately 25–30
💰 $150/day
📅 Required for 1 shooting day
A grounded, believable character who briefly enters the story but plays an important role within the scene.
The character is essentially a male Karen — opinionated, confrontational, and somewhat irritating — but should still feel like a real, believable person rather than a caricature.
Looking for an actor with strong comedic timing who can deliver the character naturally while fitting into the darker tone of the film.

📩 HOW TO APPLY
Please submit:
📸 Headshot
📄 Acting Resume
🎞️ Demo Reel / Acting Reel
📍 Current Location
🎭 Role You Are Applying For

Please submit to our email.
Email: Admin@BigQStudios.com

Selected actors will receive additional character information and audition/self-tape instructions.
Serious submissions only.

We are looking for talented performers who can bring grounded, believable performances to a dark, unsettling, and psychologically intense cosmic-horror story.

🎬 If you or someone you know is a strong fit, send them this casting call.

#filmproduction #ProductionCompany #florida #filmmaking #acting #castingcalls

🎬 CASTING CALL — MEGAN
TV Series: BUDDIES

Role: Megan

Filming Dates: October 3rd & 4th

Location: Dallas, Texas 

Compensation: Unpaid / Non-Paid Role

Food Provided: Yes

Production Credit: Yes

ABOUT MEGAN

We are looking for a Black female actress to play Megan, a beautiful, confident social media influencer who knows exactly how to use her looks and personality to get attention.

Megan is attractive, stylish, confident, and has a strong social-media presence. She should naturally give off that “I know I’m bad” type of energy and be comfortable portraying someone who gets attention wherever she goes.

The role is comedic and requires someone who can be confident, playful, flirtatious, and natural on camera.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 • Black female actress

 • Attractive / camera-friendly

 • Confident and charismatic

 • Strong social-media influencer vibe

 • Comfortable with flirtatious and playful dialogue

 • Good comedic timing

 • Comfortable being on camera

 • Reliable and available October 3rd & 4th

Acting experience is preferred but not required.

COMPENSATION

This is a non-paid independent TV series production.

🍽️ Food will be provided during filming.

🎬 Production/screen credit will be provided.

items.text:
🎭PERFORMERS WANTED - RESTORATION COMEDY🎭

Dorset Garden Theatre Company is casting an ensemble for a script-in-hand development reading of George Etherege’s She Would If She Could, taking place in Pimlico on Friday 30th October, with two rehearsal evenings earlier that week.

Unpaid development reading; £20 travel contribution, refreshments and access to a recording provided. 

The project is being developed towards a potential full production in 2027.

Roles: 

Lady Cockwood — Playing age 40–55

The central comic force of the play: a romantic, theatrical and scheming married woman determined to pursue an affair with the younger Courtall while terrified of discovery.

Sentry — Any playing age

Lady Cockwood’s knowing maid and confidante, who understands all her mistress’s schemes and is quite prepared to profit from them.

Ariana — Playing age 20–30

Gatty’s younger, more romantic sister, drawn into the games of flirtation, disguise and deception surrounding her.

Freeman — Playing age 20–35

Courtall’s friend and fellow rake, whose confidence and enthusiasm repeatedly draw him further into the complications of the plot.

Sir Oliver — Playing age 50–65

Lady Cockwood’s self-important husband, who is attempting an affair of his own while remaining oblivious to his wife’s schemes.

Sir Joslin — Playing age 50–65

Ariana and Gatty’s jolly, convivial guardian, whose fondness for drink and wayward ways sit somewhat awkwardly alongside his determination to see everyone happily married.

Full details and applications via Mandy:

Lady Cockwood’s knowing maid and confidante, who understands all her mistress’s schemes and is quite prepared to profit from them.

Ariana — Playing age 20–30

Gatty’s younger, more romantic sister, drawn into the games of flirtation, disguise and deception surrounding her.

Freeman — Playing age 20–35

Courtall’s friend and fellow rake, whose confidence and enthusiasm repeatedly draw him further into the complications of the plot.

Sir Oliver — Playing age 50–65

Lady Cockwood’s self-important husband, who is attempting an affair of his own while remaining oblivious to his wife’s schemes.

Sir Joslin — Playing age 50–65

Ariana and Gatty’s jolly, convivial guardian, whose fondness for drink and wayward ways sit somewhat awkwardly alongside his determination to see everyone happily married.

Full details and applications via Mandy:

🎭 **PAID PERFORMER OPPORTUNITY – REGULAR FRIDAY & SATURDAY EVENTS, LONDON NW10** ✨

Swivel Entertainment is building a roster of professional performers for a rotating entertainment programme at a large venue in NW10.

We’re looking for visually exciting acts to perform on selected Friday and Saturday evenings. The programme will feature several short performances spread throughout a two-hour entertainment window, potentially combined with walkabout, meet-and-greet or audience interaction.

We’d love to hear from:

🔥 Fire performers
✨ LED and glow performers
🎪 Acrobats, contortionists and speciality circus acts
💃 Cabaret, showgirl and burlesque performers
🇧🇷 Samba and carnival dancers
🪩 Roller-skating dancers
🌙 Belly dancers
🌟 Bollywood and Bhangra dancers
👠 Drag performers and hosts
🎭 Walkabout and roaming entertainers
🎡 Cyr wheel, pole, juggling, hand-balancing and other unusual visual acts

We’re also open to other professional acts that would work well on a large stage or throughout the venue.

To apply, please send:
* Your name or act/company name
* Your performance style
* Current showreel or performance videos
* Act length and available formats
* Availability on Fridays and Saturdays
* Your standard fee and best rate for recurring bookings
* Any travel costs
* Technical, stage and changing-room requirements
* Whether your act is suitable if children are present
* Confirmation of public liability insurance
* Your London base or travel location

This is a paid opportunity with the potential for ongoing, rotating work. Dates will be offered according to the entertainment programme and performer availability.

The venue’s identity and full event details will be shared with shortlisted performers at the appropriate stage. **All enquiries, communication and bookings for this opportunity will be managed through Swivel Entertainment.**

Please email your information to **[info@swivelentwetainment.co.uk](mailto:info@swivelentwetainment.co.uk)** with the subject line **London Performer Application**.

Feel free to tag or share with suitable artists! ✨

ich bin auf der Suche nach einer Möglichkeit, als Kleindarsteller oder Komparse bei verschiedenen Film- und Fernsehproduktionen mitzuwirken. Besonders interessieren mich Serien und Produktionen wie zum Beispiel „Hubert ohne Staller, aber auch andere ähnliche Formate.....

Wisst ihr vielleicht, wie man am besten an solche Rollen kommt? Muss man sich dafür bei einer Casting- oder Komparsenagentur bewerben oder gibt es andere Möglichkeiten, sich direkt bei Produktionsfirmen vorzustellen?

Vielen lieben Dank schon einmal! 😊

CASTING CALL | FOURCE

ISO: RAPPERS, DANCERS & SINGERS
Fource is looking for two new members to join our global girl group.

AUDITIONS
Applicants must be 18+.
Submit your audition here:
https://forms.gle/TqzVJZ2rsbizgWQ77

ABOUT FOURCE
Fource is an independent global girl group based in the United States that follows the K-Pop system. We create and perform original music and choreography.
Our concept is centered around the five elements: Water, Earth, Fire, Air, and Spirit.
We are currently casting for the Air and Fire elements.

AIR ELEMENT
Personality: Bubbly, energetic, and “sunshine”
Preferred Vocal Range: Mid Alto to High Soprano
Preferred Role: Main Rapper / Main Dancer
Inspirations: Rei Ami, Tate McRae, Sabrina Carpenter, Lisa, Rosé, Yuki, Yeji, Rei
We are looking for someone with strong stage presence, versatility, charisma, and an energetic performance style.

FIRE ELEMENT
Personality: Confident, grounded, and charismatic
Preferred Vocal Range: Alto to Low Soprano
Preferred Role: Main Dancer
Inspirations: Manon of KATSEYE, JENNIE, Savanna of Girlset, Yeji, Alexa, Bailey Sok
We are looking for someone with strong dance ability, confidence, natural charisma, and commanding stage presence.

For questions, comment below or contact FourceBand@gmail.com.

We’re looking for dedicated performers who are ready to grow, create, and perform with Fource.

Currently unpaid but in process of payment options. 

#Fource #FourceBand #CastingCall #GirlGroup #GlobalGirlGroup #KpopInspired #Auditions #SingerAudition #DancerAudition #RapperAudition

**URGENT LOS ANGELES CASTING — BLACK BOY, AGES 10–14**

Hey everyone, my name is Dayna Iniguez and I’m helping with casting for an independent short film, directed by Los Angeles filmmaker Reginald “Reggie” Hughes. We shoot **this Sunday, August 23**, so this is an **urgent casting search** trying to fill one remaining youth role. We are looking for a **Black boy around 10–14 years old **to play MAN-MAN, a small but pivotal supporting role.

**What we’re looking for:**
• Comfortable taking direction
• Acting experience is **not required**
• Parent/guardian involvement is required

**Compensation:** Unpaid
**Provided:** Meals, screen credit, and footage

This is a small independent narrative production with a professional crew, open to first-time performers. If you have a son, nephew, younger brother, cousin, student, athlete, or know **any Black boy ages 10–15 who may be interested**, please **tag/share this with their parent or guardian**.

Interested parents/guardians can **message me directly**, and I can connect you with Reggie and send over the script, character information, schedule, and full production details.

**Director:** Reginald “Reggie” Hughes

PL (ENG below)

Siemka!

Szukam kilku aktorek do krótkometrażowego eksperymentalnego filmu animowanego (horror). 
Film opowiada historię młodej dziewczyny, Sexy, która wyprowadza się na nawiedzone Rondo, gdzie

poznaje ducha Sabiny. Razem budują ,,kontrowersyjną społeczność”.

GDZIE? - Poznań

KIEDY? - sierpień / wrzesień

Scenariusz jest w języku angielskim.

SPOSÓB PRACY - animacja jest zrobiona ze zdjęć, więc każda z aktorek będzie fotografowana

osobna, a następnie oddzielnie nagrywany będzie dubbing.

Produkcja jest oddolna, więc niestety nie mogę zaoferować żadnego wynagrodzenia. Oferuje

natomiast koszty transportu dla osób zainteresowanych współpracą z innych miast w Polsce.

Kontakt - sabinagr99@pm.me

Instagram - https://www.instagram.com/sabina_gryczan/

———————————————————————————-

ENG

Hi!

I’m looking for actresses for my new short, experimental animated film (horror). It tells a story of a young

woman, Sexy. She moves to a haunted Roundabout where she meets Sabina, ,,friendly” ghost.

Together they built a ,,controversial community” .

WHERE? - Poznań, Poland

WHEN? - August / September

Script is in English.

WORK FLOW - animation is made with photos, so each actress will be photographed separately

and then we will record dubbing independently.

This is a grassroots production, so sadly I cannot offer any money. I can only cover travelling costs

for people from different cities in Poland.

Contact - sabinagr99@pm.me

Instagram - https://www.instagram.com/sabina_gryczan/

animation style - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9SXxWmK84WU

Film & TV Teacher - PQA Haywards Heath
Are you ready to inspire the next generation of filmmakers? Are you a filmmaker or have industry knowledge of film and television production? Then PQA Haywards Heath want to hear from you!

PQA, a leading provider of weekend performing arts training, is currently looking for a local filmmaker to work with our students at Warden Park Secondary Academy, (RH17 5DP) on a Saturday morning and afternoon (Starting at £60 per session), devising and shooting short films with students.

You will be leading filmmaking workshops with children from 6 – 18 years creating material that can ultimately be screened in a local cinema and shared online. You will ideally have some experience working with children and young people and have a strong background making short films or television.

PQA follows safer recruiting. An enhanced DBS on the update service will be required and can be arranged.

For more information or to apply please email Florence.tingley@pqacademy.com with a CV and covering letter.

# **Looking for Cupid - Berlin, native English speaker for YouTube series**

**Gerne auch weiterleiten, falls jemand jemanden kennt aus Berlin **

**You always wanted to host a reality dating show? **Zodia is a new YouTube channel about modern dating and relationships with a host called *Cupid*. We film real blind dates, debates on modern dating, and relationship content.

**What we're looking for:**
* Female, Native English speaker
* Based in Berlin, free for filming on Sundays roughly once every 4–6 weeks
* Comfortable on camera, social media experience is a plus, good with strangers
* Genuinely up for becoming the face of a channel and growing with the brand - not just doing one shoot
* Shared feministic values: Respectful dating, embracing diversity, and equality.

The channel is quite new, and YouTube realistically takes a long while before it pays anything at all.

**What I can offer is:**
* A share of the revenue once the channel does monetise
* Creative decision making around Cupid and the content
* A relaxed, professional filming environment with lots of exciting moments during filming
* A chance to increase your social media presence as well

You're completely free to chose how much time you'd like to invest in this project. The filming sessions once every 4-6 weeks will only take about 6-8 hours.

**If you're interested, **please Email hey.zodia@gmail.com, or just comment below / drop me a DM. A few sentences about yourself and anything of you on camera (Instagram, showreel, self-tape, etc.) would be great.

Here's what we make: youtube.com/@Hey-Zodia and instagram.com/hey.zodia

Looking forward to hearing from you!!

**CASTING CALL - SHORT STUDENT FILM - NON-UNION**

**Shoot Date: **Sunday Aug 23rd**, **2026

**Location: **East Vancouver, BC

**Compensation:** Non-paid (volunteer)

We're casting two middle-aged men and two middle-aged woman to be in our short film. 

**Synopsis: **They're bored, so they found something to do. Maya and Daniel have something to hide, and so do Sophie and Alex. Between secret meetings and charged innuendos, one secret binds them all together. 

## Roles:
1. **Maya (Female, 35-50): **Maya is the witty and introverted English teacher who is exceptionally good at her newfound talent, miming. 
2. **Sophie (Female, 35-50): **Sophie is the cool, calm and collected art teacher** **whose sharp as a whip. She's oftentimes bored, and is looking for something fun to do to spice up her life. (May have to smoke a fake cigarette)
3. **Daniel (Male, 35-50): **Daniel is the macho man. Think cool gym teacher with an ego. He enjoys teasing others and is a bit of a goof ball. 
4. **Alex (Male, 35-50): **Alex is an anxious chemistry teacher who DREADS keeping secrets. He is, however, determined to impress Maya with his skills. 

**Please submit your CV and reel to auditions@kyliehatton.com using subject line: FATAL ATTRACTION - (Role) - (Your name).**

**Communication done through email ONLY**

**Additional Info:**
* Information about rehearsal will be communicated to you
* Sophies role may have to smoke a fake cigarette

Looking forward to potentially working with you :)

🏨 LOOKING FOR QUALITY ENTERTAINMENT FOR YOUR HOTEL OR CORPORATE EVENT?
At Compañía de Variedades Gálatas, we are the artistic ally your business needs. We don't offer a simple show—we offer an experience that builds guest loyalty, elevates your brand, and generates visual content your clients will share on social media. 🎭✨

---

🎪 What can we do for your company?

✅ Nightly shows for hotels and resorts – Variety shows featuring magic, clowning, juggling, and physical comedy. Perfect for adult and family audiences.

✅ Street parades and roaming entertainment – Stilt walkers, giant puppets, and larger-than-life characters that activate pools, lobbies, and common areas.

✅ Thematic ambiance for buffets, gala dinners, and bar areas – Handcrafted scenography and performances that turn a meal into an unforgettable visual experience.

✅ Activations for corporate events, trade fairs, and product launches – We attract attention, generate photos, and create moments that connect with your audience.

✅ Custom characters and mascots – We design any character your hotel or brand needs for campaigns and promotions.

✅ Total flexibility – We adapt to your spaces, schedules, and needs. We create custom setups based on your requirements.

---

🏆 Why is Gálatas your best choice?

🎭 10 years of uninterrupted track record in the Cuban tourism sector.

🏨 We work with the best hotel chains: Meliá Hotels International, Grupo Gaviota, Blue Diamond Hotels & Resorts, Blau Hotels & Resorts, Barceló Hotel Group, and Iberostar Hotels & Resorts.

🎪 Participation in key events: FIT 2025 and 2026 (Cuba's International Tourism Fair), Gourmet Varadero Fair 2025 and 2026, and the International Street Theater Festival 2025.

🎨 In-house craftsmanship – We design and manufacture our own costumes, props, and sets. This allows us to customize any theme without relying on external suppliers.

🌍 Universal language – Our specialty is mime and pantomime. We don't use words. A guest from any country understands and enjoys our show. This removes barriers and expands your reach.

🤝 Professional team of 6 people – Versatile, disciplined, and experienced in the demanding pace of a resort.

---

📊 Benefits for your business:

✔️ Higher guest satisfaction – Quality entertainment is one of the top-rated factors in hotel surveys.

✔️ Social media content – Our characters and shows generate photos and videos that your guests share, giving you organic visibility.

✔️ Differentiation from competitors – A unique, high-level artistic offering positions your hotel as a premium destination.

✔️ Guest loyalty – Guests remember emotional experiences. And we are experts at creating emotions.

---

📅 How do we get started?

We are available to:

📩 Send you our complete artistic portfolio (photos, videos, technical sheets, and references).

🎥 Hold a virtual meeting to present our proposal in detail.

📝 Adapt our shows for 1‑, 3‑, or 6‑month seasons.

✈️ Travel with all documentation in order and immediate availability.

---

📩 Contact us now and let's talk about how we can collaborate.

📱 WhatsApp: +53 5 2030860

📧 Email: luise9209@nauta.cu

📸 Instagram/TikTok: @lianet_valero

📍 Matanzas, Cuba

🤝 Professional team of 6 people – Versatile, disciplined, and experienced in the demanding pace of a resort.

---

📊 Benefits for your business:

✔️ Higher guest satisfaction – Quality entertainment is one of the top-rated factors in hotel surveys.

✔️ Social media content – Our characters and shows generate photos and videos that your guests share, giving you organic visibility.

✔️ Differentiation from competitors – A unique, high-level artistic offering positions your hotel as a premium destination.

✔️ Guest loyalty – Guests remember emotional experiences. And we are experts at creating emotions.

---

📅 How do we get started?

We are available to:

📩 Send you our complete artistic portfolio (photos, videos, technical sheets, and references).

🎥 Hold a virtual meeting to present our proposal in detail.

📝 Adapt our shows for 1‑, 3‑, or 6‑month seasons.

✈️ Travel with all documentation in order and immediate availability.

---

📧 Email: luise9209@nauta.cu

📸 Instagram/TikTok: @lianet_valero

items.text:
**CASTING CALL – Child & Adult Models | PAID**

I'm casting children and adults for **Round **Two of a** larger non-speaking product video project** featuring creative building toys. Non-union.

I'm currently building out my talent roster for this next phase, with filming expected to take place mid-to-late September in the Lower Mainland, BC.

**CURRENTLY CASTING**

**Group 5**
* Age 5–7, Female, Asian
* Age 8–11, Male, Asian

**Group 6**
* Age 6–8, Male, Hispanic
* Age 6–8, Female, Hispanic
* Mixed ethnicity / mid-skinned children may also be considered

**Group 7**
* Age 6–9, Female, Caucasian
* Age 6–9, Male, Black / dark-skinned

**Group 8**
* Age 5–7, Female, Caucasian
* Age 8–11, Female, Asian

**Group 9**
* Age 5–7, Male, Asian
* Age 8–10, Female, Asian

**Group 10**
* Age 5–7, Male, Black 
* Age 8–11, Female, Black
* Mixed ethnicity / dark-skinned children may also be considered

**Group 11**

Children:
* Age 5–7, Female, Caucasian
* Age 8–11, Male, Asian
* Age 8–11, Female, Mixed Ethnicity

Adults:
* Age 36–45, Male, Caucasian
* Age 25–35, Female, Asian
* Age 60+, Female, Mixed Ethnicity

We're looking for talent who are comfortable on camera and able to follow simple direction. For child roles, we're looking for kids who enjoy playing and interacting naturally with toys.

Previous acting or modelling experience is welcome, but **not required**.

**PROJECT DETAILS**
* Non-speaking roles
* Filming: Mid-to-late September
* Location: TBD-Lower Mainland, BC
* Pay: $50 CAD/hour with a 3-hour minimum guarantee ($150 minimum per person)
* Most talent will likely be needed for approximately 1–2 hours
* A parent or guardian must remain on set for all child participants

**IMPORTANT – USAGE & CONFIDENTIALITY**

This project is being produced under a strict client confidentiality clause. Finished videos will be used digitally across the client's Amazon, website, social media, and online advertising.

Finished videos and production materials cannot be provided to talent or used for portfolios, demo reels, social media, or personal use. **Please only apply if you are comfortable with these terms.**

**PREVIOUSLY SUBMITTED?**

If you have **already emailed me about your child for phase 1 of this project, you do not need to apply again.** I have your information on file and will be reaching out for this next phase if you or your child may be a fit for one of the roles.

**TO APPLY**

Please email **[runestonepics@gmail.com](mailto:runestonepics@gmail.com)** with:
* Group number(s) you're applying for
* Applicant's name, age, and gender
* A few recent photos (casual phone photos are perfectly fine)
* General availability in mid-to-late September
* Previous acting or modelling experience, if applicable

**Subject Line:** Group # – Age – Gender
Example: **Group 5 – Age 6 – Female**

If your child fits more than one group, feel free to include all applicable group numbers.

If you have two children who fit both roles within the same group, please include both children in one email and provide the requested information and photos for each child.

Selected applicants will be contacted with additional project details, filming dates, and required forms.

Open Casting Call!

**CU Denver senior thesis film**

**Title:***** ****NO SAINTS*

**Genre: **Supernatural / Drama

**Logline: **An angel confronts a murderer.

**Characters:**

Lucy: 25-40 F

Civil war has come upon America again, and Lucy’s brother is drafted, leaving her to care for his two children. She’s educated and capable, and was meant for something more than this– but what other option is there?

A month ago, she discovered an enemy trooper hiding in the barn, and killed him in a panic. She pushes this secret deep down, but the guilt is eating her alive.

Soldier/Angel: 25-40 M

An angel, sent from Heaven to roam the Earth and collect confessions from sinners. He’s cold and calculating, and has no sympathy for the people he visits. What does it matter, as long as the job gets done? 

Monica: 15-18 F

Lucy’s niece, old enough to want to know more about the war and what she can do to help the family, to Lucy’s chagrin. 

Corey: 5-10 M

Lucy’s nephew, observant beyond his years. He doesn’t speak, expressing himself through his drawings instead. 

**Compensation:** Compensation for gas, meals, film credit, film copy

**Audition Information:** 

Please fill out the form below! Callbacks will be held in person, scheduled at a time that works for you. 

[Self-Tape Form](https://forms.gle/DWUHDLsoNA1sJPLw9) 

**Shoot Dates: **The goal is late October-early November, depending on everyone's schedules. 4 days for Lucy and the Soldier, likely only 2 days for the kids.

**Shooting Locations: **A cabin in Idaho Springs, and one other location TBD

If you have any questions whatsoever, please email [eloradodrill@gmail.com](mailto:eloradodrill@gmail.com). We’d love to work with you!

items.text:
**CASTING CALL**

**Title: **Take Me to Ithaca

**Genre: **Comedy, Action, Road-trip

**Log line:**

A darkly funny road-trip crime story about a hitman who wants out—and the unlikely friendship that gets in his way.

**Contact Info**: [Sawyer.macres@gmail.com](mailto:Sawyer.macres@gmail.com)

**Production Type: **Indie

**Run Time: **Feature Film

**Compensation: **Paid (Day Players) / Stipend (Extras) Copy, Credit

**Dates: October / November (Weekends)**

**Location: Denver / Loveland, CO**

**Union Status: **non-union

*****Most roles have been filled for this project, but still casting for the following:**

**Crystal (Female) (20-30s)  (Day Player): **

A prostitute drifting through the world.

**Anna (Female) (10-14) (Day Player):**

The cello-playing niece of Charlie, a mobster who runs an underground crime syndicate. Anna’s goal is to play a perfect recital for her uncle + family but caves under the pressure and ends up botching the solo. Ideally looking for a cello player or someone who could “act” like they do.

**Anna’s Mother ( Female) (40’s) (Extra):**

Part of a mob family.

**Anna’s Father ( Male) (40’s) (Extra)**

Part of the mob family.

**8 - 10 Mobster Bodyguards (Male) (Extras)**

Tough, no-nonsense hitmen and mobsters.

**3 Waitresses (20’s) (Female) (Extras):**

Mexican-American waitresses that work at their dad’s restaurant. Bonus points for the ability to blow a bubble with chewing gum.

**Extras, Misc (Extras):**

We have scenes we’re looking to fill with extras, so if you’re interested in being on a film set, please reach out!

Audition Information: please send headshots, resume and/or reel to the email above.
